title: Quarterly sprint sculpting for Hosted API + Model Catalog with stakeholder cadence
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Run a focused quarter-level planning sprint to convert strategy-level objectives for Hosted API and Model Catalog into a prioritized, commit-ready backlog. Deliverables: (1) a prioritized set of initiatives mapped to OKRs and measurables, (2) a stakeholder cadence and decision matrix for mid-quarter trade-offs, (3) clear handoff stories for engineering and design with success criteria and risk mitigations. This ticket coordinates cross-functional inputs (runtime, SDK, console, research) and consolidates gating criteria for model onboarding and hosted endpoint guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A ranked list of initiatives (owner, estimate, success metric) covering hosting, model onboarding, and catalog maintenance is published in Confluence. 2) A 6-week execution plan with canary windows, rollout owners, and rollback triggers is added to the roadmap board. 3) Stakeholder cadence (weekly sync + decision triage) is agreed and calendar invites distributed. 4) All dependent ENG tickets have initial estimates and at least one eng owner assigned.
comments: 2026-03-02: Kickoff workshop with PMs, Eng leads, and Design. Collected 18 candidate initiatives from product intake (doc: https://confluence.redwood/team/hostedapi-q3-sculpt).

2026-03-04: Quick cost/benefit triage done with runtime and infra — initial gating on quantization rollout and dedicated capacity footprint (see spreadsheet: https://drive.redwood/hostedapi/q3-sculpt-financials.xlsx).
2026-03-05: Design provided first draft of catalog UX options for variant labeling and deprecation flows (Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/catalog-deprecation-v1).

2026-03-07: PM/Engineering alignment session — agreed to split initiatives into 'Platform Enablers' and 'Customer-facing' buckets. Assigned preliminary owners and estimates. Added ENG dependencies to the ticket.
2026-03-09: Created roadmap board and seeded with top 8 initiatives. Linked to tracking PR template and evaluation checklist (example PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmap/pull/312).

2026-03-11: Risk review with Security & Compliance: model onboarding changes flagged for minimal data residency docs; security_review_required set to false for planning phase but will be required for final rollout. Note: file an SSO/KMS follow-up during execution.

2026-03-12: Stakeholder cadence agreed — weekly 30m sync on Thursdays, decision triage on alternate Tuesdays. Sent calendar invites and published decision matrix in Confluence. Next steps: finalize scope by 2026-03-18 and open sub-issues for engineering work.
outcome: A commit-ready quarterly roadmap for Hosted API and Model Catalog that balances latency/cost enablers with customer-facing catalog improvements, plus a documented stakeholder rhythm and triage process to manage mid-quarter trade-offs.
